messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We value our strong relationship and are always glad to work with you from our extensive bearing catalog and dedicated service support.

We appreciate your proposal for faster payment and a 24-month contract duration. Currently, our main offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. In exchange for the 14-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €4.87 per unit, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please provide the formal data supporting your binding volume commitment of 20,000 pieces per year. Which volume can you commit to? Regarding pricing structures, material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (2)
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
Here is the background.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We have reviewed your official forecast and appreciate the proposed 36-month commitment.
In exchange for the 60-day payment terms and the extended contract duration, we can offer a revised price of €4.91 per unit.
Please note that we cannot accommodate further price reductions.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (3)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us again. We appreciate your revised packages and the adjustments you have made. 

We always strive to support you with our extensive stock and dedicated service. However, we are unable to offer any further price reductions for the 36-month contract with 60-day payment terms. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer must remain at a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

We value your partnership highly and hope this proposal allows us to continue our cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
